historical_reviews.deepseek: The hybrid automation boundary is reasonable, but one generic AC observation cannot prove LastState in both directions and the CPU checkpoint is omitted.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Reclassification and three-phase coverage are accepted: ON preservation, OFF preservation and post-swap boot, each with its own state identity.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code searches found no duplicate variant or completed record; AlwaysOn/AlwaysOff neighboring rows cannot substitute for memory of the previous chassis state.
historical_reviews.v3_1: LastState is a transition relation rather than a single expected state, so each AC cut must record the pre-loss chassis state and compare only with its own post-restore observation.

original_test_intent: Verify that LastState restores an ON chassis to ON and preserves an OFF chassis as OFF across separate controlled AC-loss events, then satisfy the additional CPU-replacement boot checkpoint from Criteria.
original_method: Set/read back LastState; create and record a clean ON state, cycle the mapped PDU and verify automatic ON; independently create and record a clean OFF state, cycle AC and verify it remains OFF; then under a defined qualified procedure replace the approved CPU and validate post-swap power-on/POST/boot before restoring policy and hardware baselines.
manual_activity: A qualified operator establishes and witnesses each pre-cut state, controls both PDU cycles and performs the de-energized CPU swap; automation may set/read policy and correlate chassis/boot evidence.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/BMC/System endpoint and LastState semantics
Mapped PDU outlet, AC dwell and power-state observer
Definition of clean ON and graceful OFF pre-cut states
Exact CPU before/after parts, socket/stepping and BIOS/AGESA compatibility
Pinned private script revision or reviewed equivalent
safety_requirements: Approve policy write and each power event separately
Never hot-pull a working service to manufacture the ON case; isolate and quiesce first
Record the pre-cut state immediately before each AC removal
Do not let the first scenario's resulting state become an unrecorded input to the second
Use protected credentials and validated endpoint
De-energize and apply ESD/thermal controls for CPU service
Stop on state mismatch, BMC loss, boot/thermal fault or reboot loop
Preserve SEL/POST/OS evidence and never auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Capture identity, policy, workload and power baseline
Set/read back LastState only after approval
Timestamp and reconcile two operator-controlled PDU cycles against their recorded initial states
Capture CPU identity and post-swap boot/thermal evidence
engineer_actions: Approve the two starting-state procedures and AC timing
Approve exact CPU BOM and physical service
Operate or supervise PDU and CPU replacement

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its generic policy query and manual AC note do not distinguish ON-to-ON from OFF-to-OFF and omit the criteria-only CPU swap; filtered GET and unsafe credential/TLS examples are insufficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: With approvals, set/read LastState, separately record and AC-cycle a clean ON state and a clean OFF state, compare each result to its own pre-cut state, then perform the exact approved CPU swap and post-swap boot check before baseline restoration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Two LastState scenarios, CPU-swap criterion and 20/40-minute estimates remain; the missing Procedure step is recorded rather than dropped.

modernized_recommendation.status: APPROVAL-GATED BIDIRECTIONAL LASTSTATE AND CPU-SWAP QUALIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Maintain two state-transition records `(pre=ON, post=ON)` and `(pre=OFF, post=OFF)` with policy and PDU timestamps, then a separate CPU service/POST/boot record and final reconciliation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the two initial states auditable, restores the criteria-only CPU checkpoint and adds recovery/security/physical-service controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single successful AC cycle proves only one branch of LastState; neither branch proves boot stability after CPU replacement.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Stale chassis telemetry or incomplete shutdown can mislabel the pre-cut state, while CPU replacement adds independent socket, thermal and firmware risks.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define whether the criteria-only CPU check occurs before, between or after the two policy scenarios and whether it requires another AC stimulus. That sequencing cannot be inferred, but it is a normal required input rather than a contradiction in policy behavior.
expected_evidence: Redacted SUT/BMC/PDU/CPU/BIOS/AGESA identity, approvals and original/final policy
Protected LastState write response and complete readback
ON pre-cut evidence, first PDU timeline and ON post-restore/boot evidence
OFF pre-cut evidence, second PDU timeline and OFF post-restore evidence
Exact CPU service identity plus post-swap POST/boot/thermal/early-DXE evidence
Preserved SEL/audit/console logs, recovery and baseline restoration plus engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and the first two Criteria agree on bidirectional LastState behavior. The CPU-swap acceptance is missing from Procedure but is an additional compatible checkpoint, not an alternate power policy.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The purpose is executable after normal owner inputs define the two initial states, PDU controls, exact CPU procedure, sequencing and recovery.

review_improvement: Defines LastState as two independently evidenced transitions and restores the criteria-only CPU-swap checkpoint with explicit physical and recovery controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: LastState cannot be validated by inspecting the configured enum or by one cycle: correctness is conditional on the chassis state retained before AC loss. The ON and OFF branches must therefore have separate provenance, and the later CPU swap changes platform identity enough to require its own boot oracle rather than inheriting either branch result.
